spoken_summary: An unnamed judge administers the oath of office for the Governor of New Jersey, which Mikie Sherrill repeats line by line. She swears to support the U.S. and New Jersey constitutions and to faithfully execute the duties of her office "under the authority of the people."

intended_effect: To celebrate Mikie Sherrill's inauguration and inform supporters and the public that she is now officially the Governor of New Jersey.
